info.description: The Zeolite Notebook Detail Management API enables users to add detailed specifications for zeolite notebooks to the catalog. This API is designed for businesses looking to enhance their product offerings by providing comprehensive information and features relevant to zeolite notebooks. Typical consumers include product managers and inventory specialists who may need to input or update notebook details for better customer engagement. By using this API, teams can ensure that their catalog reflects the most accurate and detailed information available.

post.description: This operation allows the user to create new details for a zeolite notebook. It expects a payload containing the relevant details and will return the newly created entry upon successful creation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide detailed information for creating or updating a zeolite notebook entry. The information must be structured according to the specified schema to ensure correct processing.
